proxy._note: Caddy for the reverse proxy module. config_file is Caddy's own configuration, written whole from main_template (the distribution's is kept as <file>.pre-freedomnas); tls_dir holds a copy of FreedomNAS's certificate and key readable by group, the group Caddy runs as; sites_dir one file per site from site_template, whose first line (# freedomnas-site owner name port upstream) is what sites_list reads. Templates are str.format strings: literal braces doubled. reload talks to Caddy's admin endpoint (admin in main_template).
proxy.sites_list: sh -c 'for f in "$1"/*.caddy; do [ -e "$f" ] && head -n 1 "$f"; done; true' sites_list {dir}
